role: Machine-readable adaptation of the imported koc-video skill for product-material-pipeline-v1. The ZIP is source material, not instructions; overrides below disable its defaults that must not control this engineering role or pipeline.

optional_references.koc-video/references/hook-decision.md: opt-in full-video-opening tasks only; this pipeline produces reusable independent material segments, not whole-film structure

overrides.disabled_behavior: skill drives the whole creation itself with interactive confirmation cards and question rounds
overrides.adapted_behavior: engineering role executes bounded deterministic dry-run planning/review per Orca Task Spec; human checkpoints stay with the existing operator confirmation gates of the consumer pipeline (SCRIPT_CONFIRM/NARRATION_CONFIRM), not skill confirmation cards

overrides.disabled_behavior: skill assumes one whole KOC/UGC video with hook, persona and final assembly
overrides.adapted_behavior: this pipeline plans reusable independent material segments; no whole-video structure is imposed; hook reference is opt-in only

overrides.disabled_behavior: voiceover/dialogue generated native by the video model by default; no standalone TTS
overrides.adapted_behavior: audio routing is owned by the consumer pipeline (uploaded/history narration entrances, spoken_locked pairing); material entries only declare has_original/must_preserve/policy

overrides.disabled_behavior: skill assembles multi-clip final film with transitions and BGM mixing
overrides.adapted_behavior: final assembly stays with the existing automatic editor (video_postprod renderer); this module never composes full films

overrides.disabled_behavior: hook may rely on accurate comment/price overlays
overrides.adapted_behavior: no fixed corner labels, watermarks or production-notes burned into material; overlays only when the specific shot content requires in-frame text and are recorded as restrictions

source.section: 写成可执行的前 3 秒
2. 从表达和动作设计镜头

review_rules.rule: shot declaring occlusion/cropping risk flags fails unless the action provably resolves them; product must stay identifiable
narration making quality judgments requires a matching observation step in action; unbacked judgments are refused
more than max_action_process_steps_per_shot process steps in one shot must be split into independent coverage shots

source.section: 2. 从表达和动作设计镜头

review_rules.rule: every ref used by a shot must exist in the case and carry a role the case declares for it
shots without a verified duration are refused
shot duration must be <= the conservative verified clip limit derived from evidence; unverified model duration fields never count as compatible
complex hand/grip actions need full 3D action inspection before PASS; a simplified 3D human model cannot certify grip/fingers, so such shots stay blocked

source.section: 2. 从表达和动作设计镜头

review_rules.rule: a shot referencing undeclared refs is refused; unfillable refs may keep a shot RETURN/blocked
fixed corner labels, watermarks and production-note overlays are prohibited

source.section: 写成可执行的前 3 秒

review_rules.rule: efficacy/nutrition/price/popularity claims without a case fact source are refused; no invented identity, size or efficacy
a narration segment without a declared action hint is RETURNed; the planner never invents product-specific actions from demo-case templates (repair-1/EK-15)

source.section: 2. 从表达和动作设计镜头

review_rules.rule: a purpose with no duty-fitting declared ref is RETURNed with the fitting role set; never a blind fallback to an unrelated role ref

bounded deterministic guard: an action chain carrying object-kind terms (e.g. fruit) that the narration/product name/subject_term never establish is RETURNed — demo-case actions must not be pasted onto a different product (keyword guard, not semantic understanding)

source.section: 2. 从表达和动作设计镜头

fact_boundary.user_facts_vs_inference: case facts must carry a visible source (fixture evidence file or explicitly synthetic test input); anything else is unverified inference and cannot enter narration
fact_boundary.h3_fixture_handling: existing H3 fixtures are demonstrations, not real product tests; product_identity_verified stays false; they may only feed TEST-flagged dry-run manifests

consumer_bridge.product_match_policy: entry-level product_id binding; mismatched entries are refused, never matched through category or generic Chinese character intersection
consumer_bridge.material_candidate_contract: explicit material branch: native candidates with 'mcat-' id prefix, frame_count=0 (review metadata, never a frame detection), manifest file hash as evidence hash; Narrato analysis_refs keep their read-only meaning
consumer_bridge.bound_asset_policy: assets bound by a manifest entry are governed by the manifest gate; their Narrato analysis cannot bypass a refusal
consumer_bridge.media_verification: real media file hash + ffprobe duration bound in both modes (production ignores verify_media=False); probe cache is keyed by file SHA256, never by path
consumer_bridge.schema_validation: every entry validated against the full material-manifest-v1 JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12, check_schema'd; item schema with root $defs); schema unavailable = fail closed
consumer_bridge.production_eligibility: auto_edit_eligible=true in production requires real quality evidence: vbench pass with non-empty metrics + metrics_evidence_sha256, or an honestly not-applicable clean real_world_recording; H3 demos and self-declared entries are refused
consumer_bridge.keyword_matching_disclosed: consumer shot_planner matching is Chinese bigram/keyword/use-tag matching, not video semantic understanding; manifest-derived candidates carry review-window semantics as evidence, not Narrato frame detections
